title: A 200-Meter Wave in Greenland Made Earth Ring for 9 Days

scenes.text: A mountain collapsed in Greenland and Earth rang for nine days.
In September 2023, 25 million cubic meters of rock and ice crashed into a fjord.
It made a wave 200 meters high, more than twice the height of the Statue of Liberty.
The wave got trapped in the narrow fjord and sloshed back and forth every 90 seconds.
That sloshing shook seismometers around the world for nine days.
Nobody felt it. Instruments just heard Earth ringing like a bell.

description:
A mountain collapse in Greenland sent a 200 meter wave through a fjord and made seismometers worldwide shake for nine days.
The wave sloshed back and forth every 90 seconds.
Have you ever heard of a wave that shook the whole planet?
first_comment: Why do you think nobody noticed this wave for weeks?
